name: International Tennis Hall of Fame
source: International Tennis Hall of Fame; HABS; Wikipedia and Wikidata
note: The Hall of Fame shows nearly 2,000 objects from a collection of more than 30,000 artifacts, telling tennis history from its birth to today in the second floor of the 1880 Newport Casino. It publishes no online catalogue, so this guide lists its galleries and highlights named by the museum, the historic grounds, and all 271 Hall of Famers honoured with a cast racquet in the Hall of Famers Gallery. Now showing: “Tennis, Transcended: Roger Federer’s Path to Greatness” (since June 2026).
